name: Web Doc
description: Quick setup for documentation pages: a Web Doc content type organized with Book and rendered via Display Builder (part of the web* suite).
project_description:
A quick setup for documentation pages. It leverages the Book module for organizing content structure and Display Builder for rendering page layouts.

 Key features:

 A dedicated Web Doc content type.
 Book-based organization for hierarchical documentation.
 Default display powered by Display Builder.

 The module integrates with the Book module and Display Builder, and is part of the broader Drupal Website (Webship) ecosystem, which also includes UI Suite - Design Systems with Drupal.
